descriptionChirho: A proper place name in the territory of Naphtali in Galilee, referring both to a fortified city listed among the cities of Naphtali (Joshua 19:35) and to the Sea of Kinnereth (the inland lake also known as the Sea of Galilee). The variant spellings Kinnereth, Kinneroth, and Kinnerot along with prepositional forms (from Chinnereth, and Kinnereth) all designate the same geographic locale. Multilingual glosses consistently transliterate: Arabic كنرة/كنروت, Korean 킨레렛/긴네롯, Hindi किन्नेरेत, Spanish Quineret/Kinerot.
